title: Implement safe AgentOS soft-update transport and validation
goal: Build a fail-closed AgentOS soft-update pipeline that validates untrusted manifests, fetches bounded definition files read-only from GitHub, verifies content integrity, detects local conflicts, and stages updates outside the active workspace.
context: Issue #432 builds on the existing update transaction boundary. This checkpoint adds portable validation plus read-only GitHub transport and isolated staging. Activation, rollback, and SwiftUI integration remain follow-up checkpoints.
forbidden_changes: Do not load or execute downloaded native code.
Do not change App UI, Xcode project, entitlements, provider credentials, or unrelated modules.
Do not push to GitHub or mutate the active workspace during the fetch/staging phase.
Do not claim activation or rollback is implemented by the staging client.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest decoding rejects malformed metadata, wrong repository/base revision, unsupported compatibility, duplicates, and unsafe paths.
Only bounded Markdown, JSON, and text files in approved AgentOS roots are accepted.
Remote blob integrity, SHA-256 content hashes, declared byte counts, local base hashes, and local edit conflicts are verified before staging.
Fetched files are staged separately; active workspace and remote branch are not mutated.
Regression tests cover traversal, executable files, manifest round-trip, and safe-path boundaries.
verification: Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI results
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if package compilation, contract validation, or staging-boundary tests regress.
